title: Doc2EDAG: An End-to-End Document-level Framework for Chinese Financial Event Extraction

design_implication: Cross-sentence arguments and multiple event records justify document context and separate claims.
transfer_limitations: Chinese/DS labels; no transferred English accuracy; no actual correction/followup policy derived from paper
reading_limitations: Read modelling/label unit sections only; not full-paper read

title: FinQA: A Dataset of Numerical Reasoning over Financial Data

design_implication: Evidence retrieval and calculation programs are separate; execution/program accuracy have distinct limits.
transfer_limitations: Simplifies complex tables; dataset/source report redistribution rights unverified; no event extraction benchmark
reading_limitations: No dataset downloaded; no model adopted

title: FinBERT: A Pretrained Language Model for Financial Communications

design_rule: No model adopted; sentiment not materiality
